paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different conditions. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, also on a linear scale, ranging from 26 to 34 with tick intervals of 2. The plot features four lines: a purple solid line with circular markers for "Consistency-CE," starting at approximately (2, 26) and ending at (10, 31); a dark purple solid line with square markers for "Inconsistency-CE," starting near (2, 26.5) and ending at (10.5, 31.5), closely following the path of purple line. A blue dashed line with square markers for "Inconsistency-CE-MP," starting at about (2, 27) and ending at (10, 32); and a red solid line with star markers for "Consistency-Bi," starting at (3, 30.5) and ending at (11, 33). All lines show an upward trend with increasing AL, with specific data points marked at intervals. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
